painpoints.text: The fabro-96c6 cutover (commit 54761e3d9) changed planner-preflight.nu's invoking-run-id input from stdin to the FABRO_RUN_ID env but did not update its fixture battery: .fabro/scripts/dup-run-check-fixtures.nu kept piping the self id via stdin, the script silently ignored it, and the in-flight self-exclusion never fired (case j failed in run 01M52EFFSHD0DR0HJH78B14088). Fix idea: when a script's input contract changes, grep its registered battery for the old invocation shape (stdin pipe) in the same commit — or make the battery helper assert the contract it assumes.

The tester's battery-runner table redacts case names to a literal '($case)' placeholder, which makes gate-red output pinpoint which expectation failed only by its got/want values — reading the fixture source was required to map 'got RUN-PREFLIGHT, want RUN-LIVE' to line 311.

pointer_missing fires only when a description contains ZERO canonical pointers — a mixed description (one valid pointer plus another branch mention without one) escapes the flag. Acceptable boundary (the planner rule is satisfied once a usable pointer exists), noted for any future tightening.
